state.task: Inline source wording followed by explicit translations is already approved by the user, as in title="Tasks"@{nl="Taken",de="Aufgaben"}; the requested work covers all drafts and stale documentation. Keep that accepted direction fixed. The design must retain easy adoption, economical tokens, legible # prose, a sole canonical mechanism, absence of required boilerplate, unchanged business behavior and meaningful reuse. Assess the remaining choices for caption attachment and source ownership before coding. The available syntax parser supplies neither type validation nor application execution.
state.evidence: The bounded audit accounts for 1892 caption destinations: fields 913, enum values 374, models 164, scenario inputs 145, scenarios 144, roles 67, contracts 35, packages 24, derived fields 22, bool values 2 and generated CRUD actions 2. The corpus has 1521 binding rows, with 256 multi-target rows saving 371 repeated translations. Of 724 named assets, one reference occurs for 699 and two references occur for 25. Each of the 373 description assets has no parameters and exactly one reference. Every existing owner table, 51 in total, supplies en and nl with no missing cells. A typed ICU plural asset has multiple uses, and two exported wording assets pass between owners. Forty-eight message imports serve descriptions alone; another pure-message group reuses add and field_title between source owners. Reusing an enum field's type already retains its case captions; the standard vocabulary for exact name/type pairs and runtime captions requires no authored copies.
state.representation: Represent a message as its source STRING followed by @{locale=STRING-or-null,...}. An uncomplicated tag may be a NAME key; a regional tag may be quoted, for example @{"pt-BR"="Tarefas"}. This construct does not translate arbitrary objects or application data. With no suffix, a quoted string continues to denote plain literal text; @{} deliberately marks a descriptor containing only its source. Keep descriptions as unquoted # prose, permitting a single suffix on the last prose line to supply translations of the entire newline-joined description. An immediately preceding backslash escapes @{ and only that particular backslash is discarded; every other prose backslash stays part of the text. The existing #= path form remains available when a static description is shared. Derive asset identity from its canonical owner and slot rather than file offsets, public operation identifiers or keys chosen by an author.
state.source_scope: Authored text belongs to the en source locale by default for each logical package or app; an owner header may instead specify source="other-tag". That header governs the owner's description and every message value it owns, including metadata on a composed app that has no Given section. Neither composition nor import changes the locale of assets from another owner. Relocating a file leaves both owning identity and source locale intact. A context locale default continues to govern viewer preference and fallback, without defining authored-source language. Canonical BCP47 resolution must reject repeated variant tags, including a tag equal to the owner's source, and identify incomplete coverage. All current corpus text is English, so its owners need no source overrides.
state.shared_and_typed: Use Given leaves in place of required locale-column messages blocks: [export] message name[(typed_parameters)] = the same inline message value. Retain a named asset when reuse is real, covering the 25 names with multiple references and reusable assets for present multi-target bindings. Move single-use interface wording and descriptions to their sites, removing the resulting unused names and imports. Shared ICU declarations retain declared parameter types. A parameterized anonymous inline descriptor takes the existing postfix call form with explicit named arguments; infer their types from their expressions, require bindings for all placeholders appearing in any variant, and perform validation without capturing surrounding names implicitly. Keep inherited schema assets and common defaults unauthored. Preserve the meaning of stored content, fixture data, machine identifiers, guards, effects, policies, queries and current BDD observations. ICU checking, message execution and rendering have not been implemented.
state.label_alternatives: Under the compound proposal, every authored declaration caption uses the same trailing label= attribute. Its scalar value can be a static source STRING, a descriptor or the path of a shared message. For an enum/bool field or input with value captions, this attribute instead accepts the closed form {text=caption,values={case=caption,...}}; text may be absent when the existing caption suffices. Cases retain their wire values as keys, and this form also expresses overrides of inherited case assets. CRUD uses the bounded label={create=caption,update=caption,delete=caption}, limited to enabled actions. Model, contract, role, package, scenario and derived-field captions use scalars. The tradeoff is closed-object interpretation by context while enum type syntax stays unchanged. The separate-slots proposal uses caption label=, field-case labels={case=...} and create_label/update_label/delete_label for CRUD; it names each slot directly at the expense of more attributes and grammar productions. Nearby target-binding declarations keep current grouped destinations, treat action and case targets alike and carry inline translations, while repeating target identities and placing metadata outside the declaration. Every proposal leaves machine names and business authorization unchanged.

labels.instructions: Select the sole caption-attachment mechanism that best satisfies the approved inline representation, the observed field/value/action destinations, schema inheritance and limits on repetition. Compare syntax expense, readability and proximity to the owner for all alternatives. Return unresolved when the evidence does not warrant a contract.

criteria.compound: Give each owner one label attribute: ordinary captions take a scalar, while case captions and CRUD actions take a closed object. Trade context-dependent object shapes for a smaller attribute vocabulary without modifying enum syntax.
criteria.separate: Put individual caption, enum/bool-caption and CRUD-action attributes on the relevant owners. Trade a larger vocabulary and additional productions for slots with explicit names and less dependence on object context.
criteria.bindings: Place target-binding leaves next to owners, preserving grouped paths and filling them with inline descriptor values. Trade path repetition and detached metadata for identical target treatment and straightforward reuse of existing groups.
criteria.unresolved: Withhold a selection if evidence about source owners, inherited-label overrides or attachment rules is insufficient to establish a single canonical form.

scope.instructions: Does fixing authored-source language to en unless a logical owner explicitly overrides it form a consistent rule for inline descriptors, composed-app descriptions and imported assets, while deployment defaults/viewer locales stay independent and file relocation preserves canonical ownership?

typed.instructions: Would the existing postfix-call form with explicitly named arguments and expression-derived argument types work for anonymous inline ICU descriptors together with shared declarations that state parameter types, while preserving plain-string/data meaning and avoiding implicit scope capture, once the stated placeholder, type and provenance validation exists?
